data.body:
Fix pushed as Gerrit change 1109 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1109).

VERIFICATION of the ticket's claims against current main:
- AGENTS.md:75 and :106 confirmed verbatim. The library example is at :244, not :238 (stale line number, same content).
- _commands/claim.py: the fallback is at :171-172 (`if assignee is None: assignee = _config_default_assignee(tracker)`), not :124-125. Mechanism exactly as described; explicit-wins is covered by the passing tests/unit/test_claim_default_assignee.py::test_explicit_assignee_wins_over_default.
- rebar.toml:66 and docs/config.md:383-401 confirmed. Contradiction is real.

RED->GREEN: tests/unit/test_agents_claim_assignee_guidance.py, seen RED (4/5 failing) before the fix, GREEN after, and returned to RED by a mutation that restores '--assignee <you>'.

E2E replication in a scratch tracker with default_assignee set: bare 'claim <id>' -> assignee 'joeoakhart@navapbc.com' (Jira-resolvable, survives reconcile); the old form 'claim <id> --assignee RebarBotNava' -> bare handle 'RebarBotNava' (the value the inbound differ clears).

SIBLING SWEEP (found, NOT fixed — out of this ticket's declared file_impact):
- README.md:328 ('rebar claim <id> --assignee <you>' in the CLI essentials one-liner)
- .agents/rules/rebar.md:21 (same instruction)
- templates/AGENTS.md:46 and templates/rebar-usage.md:22 (shipped downstream templates; these ship with default_assignee unset, so omitting --assignee there would leave tickets unassigned — needs a separate decision, not a copy of this fix)
Test-fixture uses of assignee='me' were excluded (isolated fixtures, not guidance).
